[[Lord Onrah's Sword]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[Dread Lord Onrah]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Fahranur, The First City]].

==Stats==
*[[Slashing damage]]: 10-13 (Requires 4 [[Swordsmanship]])
*[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
*[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
*Health +20

==Replica==

*One of the following swords:
**[[Dadao Sword]] from collectors [[Master Architect Wright]] or [[Sakai]]
**[[Etched Sword]] from collectors [[Dobb]] or [[Sark]]
**[[Highlander Blade]] from collectors [[Dagnor Grubeater]] or [[Blonk]]
**[[Katana]] from crafters [[Honglei Sun]] or [[Manzo]]
**[[Long Sword]] from crafter [[Sarad]]
**[[Machete]] from collector [[Juba]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]] or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Destroyer Sword]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Sword]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Sword]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Sword Hilt]]
*Perfect [[Sword Pommel]] [[of Fortitude]]

== Unique counterparts ==
[[Deldrimor Sword (unique)]], [[Droknar's Sword]], [[Eldritch Sword]], [[Forgotten Sword]], [[Kanaxai's Edge]], and [[Reaper's Blade]] are [[perfect]] counterparts to this item.

==Notes==
* This sword has a unique skin.
* This sword already existed in the beta version of the game, as can be seen in Issue #12 (December 2004) of the GuildMaster Photics Fansite Magazine, but it was not introduced until October 27, 2006 with the release of [[Guild Wars Nightfall]] as [[unique]] weapon. The original size was bigger and without the black dye applied, as can be seen in the inventory icon, but it's unobtainable. The original name of the weapon is not known either.

{{bug|When wielded by a character, the sword is rendered black. When [[Dread Lord Onrah]] is seen wielding this sword, it is rendered similar to the inventory icon.}}
